hints.title: Group Positions by Value
hints.text: Collect all indices where each distinct number appears in the array.

hints.title: Sliding Window on Indices
hints.text: For each value, consider a sliding window [left, right] over its index list. The number of other elements between these occurrences is (pos[right] - pos[left] + 1) - (right - left + 1).

hints.title: Deletion Condition
hints.text: As long as the count of deleted elements exceeds k, increment left. Track the maximum window size right - left + 1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash map position grouping followed by two-pointer sliding window.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subarrays and counting frequencies takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for storing indices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transform the problem into sliding window on indices of equal values.
